Your shower curtain screeches every time you pull it shut

Plain plastic hooks grip the rod instead of rolling along it, so the curtain catches, sticks, and drags with every pull. Over time those same hooks rust and leave orange streaks on the rod and curtain.

These Titanker hooks are metal and rust resistant, built as double glide rings so each one rolls smoothly along the rod instead of catching. Thousands rate them around 4.6 stars for how easily the curtain moves after swapping them in.

Your curtain opens and closes in one smooth pull instead of a fight, and the whole set runs about $7.
